demo_video.requirement: Publish a 3–5 minute demo video for the Devpost submission.

devpost_registration_and_rules.requirement: Register/review/accept the hackathon rules and complete final submission.

judging_alignment.innovation_and_originality: Raw vs reconsidered vs governed comparison makes governance impact directly inspectable.
judging_alignment.technical_implementation: One bounded evaluation capability with deterministic evidence schemas and HTTP/MCP/A2A/UCP adapters.
judging_alignment.real_world_impact: Measures whether governance changes consequential agent decisions and preserves the evidence for review.
judging_alignment.user_experience_and_design: Concise comparative human report plus structured machine-readable surfaces.
judging_alignment.scalability_and_feasibility: Protocol adapters reuse one canonical capability rather than duplicating products.

claims_boundary: No private GHOSBC, Mother Language, Soul Cipher, GHX, glyph, Castle Gate implementation internals, credentials, or reconstruction material
